issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for Ride and its subclasses: the problem statement/UML require Ride to have a public constructor taking (String name, char abbreviation) (and subclasses must first accept superclass attributes). In the solution, Ride only defines public Ride(String name) and sets abbreviation internally, while RollerCoaster, LaunchedRollerCoaster and LaunchedDropdownTower call super(name, abbreviation). This is a structural inconsistency that will cause compilation errors and contradicts the specification; the template Ride.java is also empty and should provide the constructor matching the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Ensure Ride declares a public constructor matching the UML and problem statement: public Ride(String name, char abbreviation). Either add this constructor (or overload the existing one) in Ride so that RollerCoaster and other subclasses can call super(name, abbreviation), or update the subclasses and UML consistently. The preferred fix is to follow the UML/specification and provide Ride(String, char).
